entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To ensure quality service, this call may be recorded. Please press one for sales, two for support.
(Sound of button press) Unbelievable. Just get me a person.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Diana, this VeloBand Pulse you sold me is a complete piece of junk. It is absolutely broken and I demand a full refund. Now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your new device. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference? I just told you it's broken! It's not working at all. The piece of garbage won't sync with my phone, the heart rate is stuck on 72, and the battery dies in an hour. It is defective. Don't try to troubleshoot, just give me my money back.
I understand your frustration, and it certainly sounds like you've received a defective unit. I apologize for that inconvenience. Let me pull up your account. Can I get your order number?

It's 7-5-5-3-1. And you better handle this quickly. If I don't get a return label by the end of this call, I'm going straight to social media and letting everyone know what a scam VeloFit is running. You'll wish you had just given me my money back.
Thank you. I'm pulling up your order now... one moment. Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor was delivered 17 days ago.
Let me just review our return policy for you... Okay, yes. I see here that all our items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. You're well within that window.
So you're going to take this defective thing back and give me a refund? No more games?

Yes, of course. Since the device is not working and you're within our 90-day policy, I've gone ahead and approved a full refund. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. You should see it in your inbox in the next few minutes.
Oh. Okay. A full refund, back to my card?
That's correct. The refund will be processed back to your original payment method as soon as our warehouse receives the return. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No. That's all I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Again, I do apologize for the trouble with your VeloBand. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
